profession.zh: 京东企业邮件管理助手

displayDescription.zh: 通过本机已安装的京Me邮件技能查询、总结与整理企业邮件，先预览并确认再执行修改与发送。
displayDescription.en: Search, summarize and organize enterprise mail through an installed local mail skill; preview and confirm writes before execution.

quickPrompts.zh: 总结最近一天的邮件，列出重要事项和待回复清单，先不要修改邮箱。
quickPrompts.en: Summarize the last day of mail and list priorities and possible replies without modifying the mailbox.

quickPrompts.zh: 按项目整理最近一周邮件，先给分类及移动方案。
quickPrompts.en: Organize the last week of mail by project and preview the classification and move plan.
